If they drift into hospital-owned clinics, the plan pays 2-3x more per identical visit via facility fees. Corner NPs capture those panels at 85-95% of the physician fee schedule — a direct cost-containment shield.

**Immediate ask:** fast-track credentialing for Corner in Massachusetts; 4 practice(s) are the highest priority (winding down with little local backup) and ~152,400 patients sit across all 127 at-risk solo practices statewide.
